issues.failure_explanation: The prose asserts V_k(K) ⊂ [ẼV_{k+2}(K)]^2. A function v = ṽ + β of V_k(K) must satisfy the enhanced-(k+2) conditions (v − Π^∇_{k+2}v, q) = 0 for all q of degree k+1, k+2. No argument is given, and none holds in general: for ṽ ∈ ẼṼ (enhanced of degree k) the moments (ṽ, q) against degree-(k+1), (k+2) polynomials are unconstrained, and since Π^∇_{k+2}ṽ does not reproduce the trace of ṽ, (ṽ − Π^∇_{k+2}ṽ, q) = ⟨ṽ − Π^∇_kṽ, ∂_n φ⟩_∂K-type terms are generically nonzero (w := ṽ − Π^∇_{k+2}ṽ has Δw ∈ P_k and, by Green's identity, (w, Δφ) = ⟨∂_n w, φ⟩_{∂K} − a(w, φ), which is not forced to vanish). Only the weaker inclusion V_k(K) ⊂ Z_{k+2}(K) (the enlarged space, without the enhanced orthogonality) is valid.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the claimed inclusion by V_k(K) ⊂ Z_{k+2}(K) (enlarged space), or simply delete the sentence: unisolvency of dofs(v) follows directly from the direct-sum decomposition and the unisolvency of the dofs of ẼṼ and bubbleS.
issues.overall_effect: The motivating assertion for Proposition prop:added-4 is false as written; only the weaker enlarged-space inclusion holds. No other result depends on it, since unisolvency follows directly from the direct-sum structure and the known unisolvency of the enhanced and bubble degrees of freedom.
issues.title: Claimed inclusion V_k(K) ⊂ [enhanced VEM space of degree k+2]^2 is unsupported and false
issues.why_classification: A local wording/hypothesis fix (replace 'enhanced' by 'enlarged', or drop the sentence) restores correctness; Proposition prop:added-4 remains true by the direct-sum dof argument, so no substantive claim or guarantee is lost.

issues.failure_explanation: The chain concludes a_h^K(v_h,v_h) ≤ C^* a^K(v_h,v_h) by dropping the term −a^K(Q^∇_kṽ, β̄_h), which is legitimate only if a^K(Q^∇_kṽ, β̄_h) ≥ 0. No sign or smallness of this term is established anywhere. In fact, by (eq:cross-zero0)–(eq:cross-zero), a^K(Π^∇_kṽ, β̄_h) = 0 but a^K(Q^∇_kṽ, β̄_h) = −(ΔΠ^∇_kṽ, β̄_h)_K + boundary terms, and since ΔΠ^∇_kṽ ∈ [P_k]^2 only its top-degree part pairs with β̄_h; this quantity is generically nonzero and of arbitrary sign, so the displayed inequality is an invalid inference as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Bound the cross term by Cauchy–Schwarz and Young, |a^K(Q^∇_kṽ, β̄_h)| ≤ C|Q^∇_kṹ|_{1,K}|β̄_h|_{1,K} ≤ C(|ṽ|_{1,K}+|β̄_h|_{1,K})^2, absorb it with Young's inequality (using the splitting stability of Proposition prop:added-3), and conclude the upper bound with a possibly enlarged constant C^*; this is a routine constant-bookkeeping repair.
issues.overall_effect: The upper bound in the elementwise stability estimate (eq:stab) — and hence Proposition prop:stab, the continuity/coercivity of a_h, and all results built on them (well-posedness, error estimates, static condensation) — is not established by the written argument.
issues.title: Unjustified sign claim on a^K(Q^∇_kṽ, β̄_h) in the stability upper bound
issues.why_classification: A short local repair (Cauchy–Schwarz/Young absorption of the cross term, using the already-proved splitting stability) preserves the stated stability result and all downstream guarantees; no new lemma or construction is needed.

issues.failure_explanation: Since c_h(q_h,q_h) = Σ_K S_p^K(Q^0_k q_h, Q^0_k q_h), every pressure function with zero non-polynomial part, e.g. any nonzero q_h ∈ P_k(K) ∩ L²₀(Ω) ⊂ Q_k, has Π^0_k q_h = q_h and hence c_h(q_h,q_h) = 0, while δ_*‖q_h‖²_{0,Ω} > 0. The lower bound in the display therefore contradicts the defining estimate (eq:stab_sp), which holds only for the non-polynomial part Q^0_k q_h.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the display by δ_*‖Q^0_k q_h‖²_{0,Ω} ≤ c_h(q_h,q_h) ≤ δ*‖Q^0_k q_h‖²_{0,Ω} for all q_h ∈ Q_k, which is exactly what (eq:stab_sp) yields and is all that is used afterwards.
issues.overall_effect: An advertised property of the pressure stabilization (control of the full L² norm of the pressure by c_h) is false as displayed; the well-posedness and error analyses only need, and only use, the weaker kernel estimate, but the stated guarantee about c_h is not supported.
issues.title: Pressure stabilization c_h claimed coercive on all of Q_k, which is false
issues.why_classification: Local repair of one displayed statement; the well-posedness and error arguments only use the (valid) kernel version, so no substantive result or rate is lost.
